title: Dack Fayden — Dack Fayden's Party
summary: Mono-white donate-blink: Dack dumps ETB creatures, you take the enters, then each opponent is handed a goaded party guest.

tags.name: blink
tags.reason: Self-blink restamps Dack; owner-return blinks reclaim donated cages.

tags.name: donate
tags.reason: The commander gives each opponent a creature after you take its enter trigger.

tags.name: exile
tags.reason: The Fiend Hunter suite and Helvault or desert lands are the interaction package.

tags.name: forced combat
tags.reason: Donated creatures are goaded for the rest of the game, so they keep attacking someone else.

tags.name: politics
tags.reason: Who receives which goaded guest, and which cage stays closed, is a table conversation.

tags.name: ramp
tags.reason: A dense rock suite exists to cast the six-mana commander on time.

tags.name: angels
tags.reason: Several payload creatures are Angels, but there is no angel tribal payoff.

tags.name: midrange
tags.reason: The deck develops a creature board and wins in combat rather than combo.
